Name: Accordion
Description:
Arrange the content by having vertically stacked tabs that expand when clicked. This is an effective way to display additional information.

Add the Accordion Web Block on your Screen and as many AccordionItems as you need inside the Accordion.

Name: AccordionItem
Description:
An area that can be expanded or collapsed. You can change the default state of the Block using the IsExpanded input.

Can also be used within the Accordion Pattern, placed inside the Content placeholder. Drag into the Accordion Block as many items as you need.

Name: Alert
Description:
Alert box with a placeholder for custom content, supports Success, Danger, Warning and Info messages.

To disable the focus feature, use the class 'disable-alert-focus' on the ExtendedClass parameter.

Name: AlignCenter
Description:
Vertically aligns multiple elements with different heights.

Add two or more elements inside the placeholder and they will be vertically centered. Ideal to align Buttons with other different elements like text.

Name: Animate
Description:
Use this Block to emphasise elements as they come on screen or while the screen is loading.

Drag content inside the placeholder and configure the animation type of the Block. 

You can also define the amount of wait time before an animation starts and define how long the animation lasts.

Name: AnimatedLabel
Description: Input fields with labels that animate when users focus the input.

Name: AppFeedbackHelp
Description:
Displays information if the App Feedback is enabled in the application. 

This information is displayed only once for each application, once dismissed, it will never show up again.

Content inside the placeholders can be edited to display custom messages.

Name: ApplicationLoadEvents
Description: Handles the loading progress on a splash screen.

Name: ApplicationTitle
Description: Contains your application's title and logo.

Name: AreaChart
Description:
The area chart is composed of data points plotted and connected by a line with a colored area below the line. 
To customize the elements of the chart (X axis, Y axis, Series Legend, Series, or Tooltip) drag-and-drop the addons into the ChartAddons placeholder inside the Chart block. 
Note: the addons SS preview won't be visible in runtime.

Name: Badge
Description: Displays a number as notification, a nice way to notify a user about new messages or tasks.

Name: BarChart
Description:
The bar chart is a two-dimensional chart where rectangular bars are placed along the x axis with bar length representing the value for a specific category.
To customize the elements of the chart (X axis, Y axis, Series Legend, Series, or Tooltip) drag-and-drop the addons into the ChartAddons placeholder inside the Chart block. 
Note: the addons SS preview won't be visible in runtime.

Name: BlankSlate
Description: A simple box that presents an empty state to the user and provides directions. Has placeholder for an Icon, text and an action button. Works great for user onboarding.

Name: Breadcrumbs
Description:
Present the current user location in applications with a deep page hierarchy.

Usefull when you want to make an in-app navigation.

Drag it into the breadcrumb placeholder. Drag as many BreadCrumbsItems to Content as you need.

Name: BreadcrumbsItem
Description:
Used in the Content placeholder of the Breadcrumbs Block.

Fill the Title placeholder with your title.
Drag an icon to the Icon placeholder, usually "angle_right", "caret_right" or "chevron_right". Place links for the level required to offer the navigation.

Name: ButtonLoading
Description: Button with loading state when is clicked.

Name: Card
Description: Card with placeholder for Content.

Name: CardBackground
Description: Card with a background image, GIF or video. Simply drag the background element to the Background placeholder

Name: CardItem
Description: Card with placeholders for Title, Text, Left side and Right side.

Name: CardSectioned
Description: Card with placeholders for Title, Content and Footer. Title and Footer placeholders are not displayed if they are empty.

Name: Carousel
Description:
Displays multiple items in a horizontal slide. Ideal for creating horizontal slides in smaller screens. For dynamic content, place a List directly inside the placeholder. Elements inside the placeholder represent different items.

Note:
- When you place Image widgets directly inside the Carousel, the images are accessible through their alt text but aren't exposed as a list. To expose them as an accessible list, enclose each Image in a Container: the Container becomes the list item, so screen readers announce the images as a list of items and let users navigate them accordingly, while each image keeps its own image semantics and alt text.

Name: CenterContent
Description:
Vertically aligns content to the middle of its parent.

Place this block inside a container with a given height and add content to the placeholder, that content will be vertically centered. 

Ideal for full height screens without much content.

Name: ChartExport
Description:
Chart addon used to add the exporting functionality to the chart. It allows users to: View the chart in full screen, print, download as png, jpeg, pdf,svg, csv and xls. 
Drag-and-drop to the chart Addons placeholder to add exporting options to the chart.

Name: ChartLegend
Description:
Chart addon used to customize the box containing a symbol and a name for each series or data point in the chart. 
Drag-and-drop to the chart Addons placeholder to customize the series legend. 
When removed from the Addons placeholder, the legend element will not appear in runtime.

Name: ChartSeriesStyling
Description:
Chart addon used to customize the styling of the chart series. You can bind it to a specific series (by setting the SeriesName) or apply the styles to all of them (by leaving the SeriesName empty). 
Drag-and-drop to the chart Addons placeholder to customize the series styling. 
When removed from the Addons placeholder, the styling customizations will be removed.

Name: ChartXAxis
Description:
Chart addon used to customize the horizontal axis of the chart, though if the chart is inverted this is the vertical axis (e.g. Bar Chart).
Drag-and-drop to the chart Addons placeholder to customize the x axis. 
When removed from the Addons placeholder, the x axis element will not appear in runtime. 
Note: This block can't be used for the Pie and Donut charts.

Name: ChartYAxis
Description:
Chart addon used to customize the vertical axis of the chart, though if the chart is inverted this is the horizontal axis (e.g. Bar Chart).
Drag-and-drop to the chart Addons placeholder to customize the y axis. 
When removed from the Addons placeholder, the y axis element will not appear in runtime. 
Note: This block can't be used for the Pie and Donut charts.

Name: ChatMessage
Description:
Block with Chat Message content, such as user photo, text, images, delivery time and status.

After adding the user picture and message content, configure the Time and Status of the message in the Input Parameters.

Use to create chat screens or a feed of user posts

Name: ColumnChart
Description:
The column chart is a two-dimensional chart where rectangular bars are placed along the y axis with bar height representing the value for a specific category.
To customize the elements of the chart (X axis, Y axis, Series Legend, Series, or Tooltip) drag-and-drop the addons into the ChartAddons placeholder inside the Chart block. 
Note: the addons SS preview won't be visible in runtime.

Name: Columns2
Description:
Split content in 2 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: Columns3
Description:
Split content in 3 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: Columns4
Description:
Split content in 4 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: Columns5
Description:
Split content in 5 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: Columns6
Description:
Split content in 6 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: ColumnsMediumLeft
Description:
Split content in 2 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed. The left column will be smaller.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: ColumnsMediumRight
Description:
Split content in 2 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed. The right column will be smaller.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: ColumnsSmallLeft
Description:
Split content in 2 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed. The left column will be smaller.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: ColumnsSmallRight
Description:
Split content in 2 columns with responsive capabilities to improve the way information is displayed. The right column will be smaller.

Place this Block on your Screen and simply add content to each placeholder.

Name: Counter
Description:
Use counters to give feedback about the current count of several elements.

Very useful on dashboards or summary pages.

Add content to the placeholder, then, set up the orientation and Height of the Block.

Name: DatePicker
Description: Allows the user to select a single date using a calendar.

Name: DatePickerRange
Description: Allows the user to select a range of dates using a calendar.

Name: DisplayOnDevice
Description: Display content depending on which device is being used. There are placeholders for Phone, Tablet and Desktop.

Name: DonutChart
Description:
The donut chart is a circular graph that displays data in rings, where each ring represents a category and the size of the ring corresponds to the value of the data being presented.

The ChartXAxis and ChartYAxis addons are not compatible with this type of chart. 

To customize the elements of the chart (Series Legend, Series, or Tooltip) drag-and-drop the addons into the ChartAddons placeholder inside the Chart block. 
Note: the addons SS preview won't be visible in runtime.

Name: DropdownSearch
Description:
Enhanced DropdownSearch block, with search functionality.
By default, Dropdowns open as popups in mobile apps (responsive and native).

Drag the block to your screen and set the OptionsList parameter structure with your list. Use the SelectedOptions parameter to set a list with a pre-selected item.

Use: 
- The OnChanged event to assign the current list of selected values to your local variable.

Name: DropdownServerSide
Description:
Dropdown block that allows you to manage large datasets in a more flexible and efficient way. The block has less out-of-the-box logic and is targeted for more advanced use cases.

Examples:
- Pagination / infinite scroll
- Search based on queries
- Custom dropdown balloon (with footer, buttons, title, etc.)

Check more about it in: https://success.outsystems.com/Documentation/11/Developing_an_Application/Design_UI/Patterns/Using_Mobile_and_Reactive_Patterns/Interaction/Dropdown_Server_Side

Name: DropdownServerSideItem
Description: DropdownOptionItem block, this block should be use as a DropdownServerAction option item.

Name: DropdownTags
Description:
Enhanced Dropdown block, with search functionality and multiple tags selection.
By default, Dropdowns open as popups in mobile apps (responsive and native).

Drag the block to your screen and set the OptionsList parameter structure with your list. Use the SelectedOptions parameter to set a list with a pre-selected item.

Use: 
- The OnChanged event to assign the current list of selected values to your local variable.

Name: FlipContent
Description:
Flip between two placeholders.
It can be used out of the box, or it can be controled by your own variable. Works well with cards or images of the same size.

Name: FloatingActions
Description:
Display an action that floats on the bottom right of the screen, providing access to a set of additional actions. Could also be placed inside a Bottom Bar.

Add the pattern to your screen. Drag as many FloatingActionsItems as you need to the Items placeholder.

Name: FloatingActionsItem
Description:
Used within the FloatingActions Pattern. Should be placed inside the FloatingActions's Item placeholder.

Drag into the FloatingActions Pattern as many items as you need.

Name: FloatingContent
Description: Inserts a floating panel with content docked to a direction in the page

Name: Gallery
Description: Display content in gallery style with different columns per device type/orientation

Name: HighchartsModules
Description:
Extends charts by adding additional Highcharts scripts to the page.
Drag-and-drop to a screen to add additional scripts to it. 
This element will not appear in runtime.

Name: HoursCalendar
Description: Monthly calendar of the current user's day sheets: coloured day squares, month navigation, a day editor popup to log hours per project / mark a day off / confirm, and Fill all pending days.

Name: IconBadge
Description:
Icon with a Badge stacked on top of it.

Drag an Icon and Badge to their placeholders.

Used to display notifications with numbers.

Name: ImagesCSS
Description: Block that contains the CSS variables defining images in base64 to be used on the Map's stylesheet.

Name: InlineSVG
Description: Use this pattern to be able to use an SVG inline, so that you can change the fill and stroke properties, or animate the SVG paths.

Name: InputWithIcon
Description:
Customize an input with an Icon. 

Just drag your input and choose the desired icon.

Name: LayoutBase
Description: Allows the creation of a custom layout.

Name: LayoutBaseSection
Description: Adds a new section to your custom layout.

Name: LayoutBlank
Description: Adds a basic layout with a single placeholder.

Name: LayoutSideMenu
Description: Adds a layout with a menu on the side, most used in applications with several menu items.

Name: LayoutTopMenu
Description: Adds a layout with the menu on the header, most used in applications with few menu items.

Name: Licenses
Description: Contains the OutSystems platform licenses.

Name: LightBox
Description: Base elements to create the Lightbox panel that Lightbox Items open on click. The Layout already has this Block inside it.

Name: LightboxImage
Description:
Block with only one placeholder for image. It’s possible use local images or External URL, using the ImageURL parameter on the block. To be able to open items, the Utilities\Lightbox Block needs to be placed somewhere on the screen.

To disable the URL feature, use the class 'disable-url' on the ExtendedClass parameter.

Name: LineChart
Description:
The line chart is a two-dimensional chart where each point represents a single value and is connected by a line.
To customize the elements of the chart (X axis, Y axis, Series Legend, Series, or Tooltip) drag-and-drop the addons into the ChartAddons placeholder inside the Chart block. 
Note: the addons SS preview won't be visible in runtime.

Name: ListItemContent
Description: Block to use inside a List Item to create content on the left, center and right.

Name: Map
Description:
Displays an interactive map on your Reactive Web and Native Mobile apps using the Google Maps API. You can change the default behavior of your map using all the options available in the block. 
Use the AddOns blocks (Markers, Shapes and DrawingTools) to customize your map.
To add a list of markers, drag the List widget inside the AddOns placeholder together with the Marker.

For more information, visit https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/

Notes: 
- In the same application, we advise using a single map Forge component and a single Google Maps' license. 
- To use DrawingTools, SearchPlaces, or Directions APIs.

Name: MapCSS
Description: Block with the CSS needed for Maps in designtime.

Name: MapEvent
Description:
This block enables to listen to events of a given map. 
Drag-and-drop this block inside the map event placeholder and pick the event to listen. The list of events that you can listen to include: click, doubleClick, dragEnd, rightClick and zoomChanged.

Name: MarginContainer
Description: Adds a margin around this block's placeholder.

Name: Marker
Description: Adds a location to OutSystems Maps Map block.

Name: MarkerEvent
Description:
This block enables to listen to events of a given Marker on a Map. 
Drag-and-drop this block inside the marker placeholder and pick the event to listen. The list of events that you can listen to include: doubleClick, dragEnd and rightClick.

Name: MasterDetail
Description: Displays a list of items and their related details, for example, a list of employees and their corresponding details.

Name: Menu
Description: Navigation element with links to the main screens of your application.

Name: MenuDrag
Description: Contains the mobile phone screen gestures logic to apply on the menu to show its content.

Name: MenuIcon
Description: Clickable icon that allows opening the menu on small screens.

Name: MonthPicker
Description: Allows the user to select a single month and year using a calendar.

Name: MouseEvents
Description: Enables Mouse events on a specific widget.

Name: NetworkStatusChanged
Description: Triggers different events depending on the device's network connection status.

Name: Notification
Description:
Use this block to add a notification. By default, it will be displayed on top of the screen. It's ideal to create a native looking notification message.
Drag to the screen, add the notification content, and bind the variable to control the visibility of the message.

Name: OfflineDataSyncCore
Description: Synchronizes data that can be used offline.

Name: OverflowMenu
Description: Clickable element that displays hidden actions, settings, or secondary options. Use this pattern to show additional options when there is a space constraint (e.g. in toolbars or other places where a group of actions is required).

Name: Pagination
Description:
Drag the Pagination block to your screen. 
Set the StartIndex and MaxRecords parameters to the related variables from your Screen. 
Set the TotalCount parameter to the Count from the Aggregate you are using.

Use the OnNavigate event to create an action that assigns the StartIndex to the NewStartIndex. Drag a RefreshData to refresh your Aggregate.

Name: PieChart
Description:
The pie chart is a circular graph that displays data in sections, where each section represents a category and the size of the section corresponds to the value of the data being presented.

The ChartXAxis and ChartYAxis addons are not compatible with this type of chart. 

To customize the elements of the chart (Series Legend, Series, or Tooltip) drag-and-drop the addons into the ChartAddons placeholder inside the Chart block. 
Note: the addons SS preview won't be visible in runtime.

Name: ProgressBar
Description:
You can use the ProgressBar to display the current progress in a bar.
When the update frequency is high (e.g., 2 or more updates per second), the default animation speed may appear sluggish. To address this, adjust the animation speed by modifying the following CSS variables: --progress-initial-speed and --progress-speed.

To override the default animation settings, use the following CSS:

.override-speed .osui-progress-bar {
    --progress-speed: 0.1s;         /* default: 0.35s */
    --progress-initial-speed: 0.2s; /* default: 0.5s  */
}

This customization ensures that the ProgressBar remains smooth and responsive, even at high update rates.

Name: ProgressCircle
Description:
Circular progress indicator with a placeholder on the center of the circle. You can use this placeholder to show the current progress value.
When the update frequency is high (e.g., 2 or more updates per second), the default animation speed may appear sluggish. To address this, adjust the animation speed by modifying the following CSS variables: --progress-initial-speed and --progress-speed.

To override the default animation settings, use the following CSS:

.override-speed .osui-progress-circle {
    --progress-speed: 0.1s;         /* default: 0.35s */
    --progress-initial-speed: 0.2s; /* default: 0.5s  */
}

This customization ensures that the ProgressCircle remains smooth and responsive, even at high update rates.

Name: PullToRefresh
Description: Enable swiping down on the screen's content to trigger an action (usually refreshing part of the screen). The Layout already has this Block inside it.

Name: RadarChart
Description:
The radar chart, also known as Polar Chart, illustrate multivariate data in a two-dimensional chart, plotted along radial axis.
To customize the elements of the chart (X axis, Y axis, Series Legend, Series, or Tooltip) drag-and-drop the addons into the ChartAddons placeholder inside the Chart block. 
Note: the addons SS preview won't be visible in runtime.

Name: RangeSlider
Description:
Select a single value within a range, using a sliding handle.

For advanced options, read the official documentation:
https://refreshless.com/nouislider/

Note: To ensure the correct behavior of the component, we recommend not using different versions of it in the same page.

Name: RangeSliderInterval
Description:
Select an interval within a range of values, using two sliding handles.

For advanced options, read the official documentation:
https://refreshless.com/nouislider/

Note: To ensure the correct behavior of the component, we recommend not using different versions of it in the same page.

Name: Rating
Description:
Use this pattern to let your users score your products and services.

Drag the pattern to the screen and set the Rating Value parameter.

Name: ScrollableArea
Description:
Simple scrollable Block with a placeholder for content.

Ideal to display multiple elements in a single, scrollable row or column.

Name: Search
Description: Input with search icon to search within the application.

Name: Section
Description:
Use it to segment and arrange blocks of content on a page. It also allows to create a Section index if you are using both patterns in the same page.

Fill in the title, actions and content placeholders. It is possible to configure a label to use with the SectionIndex pattern.

Name: SectionGroup
Description: Use to apply sticky headers to Sections inside this Block.

Name: SectionIndex
Description:
Use the Section Index to organize a screen's content, enabling quick navigation within a page.

Just drag the pattern, and it will create a link to every section you have on the page. If you use a list of sections, add disable-virtualization=true through the Attributes section on the list widget containing the section patterns.

Use the parameter isFixed to define if it will stick on scroll and the TopPosition to change the distance to top. 

Set IsSmooth to true to enable animated scroll.

Name: SectionIndexItem
Description:
Use the Section Index to organize a screen's content, enabling quick navigation within a page.

Just drag the pattern, and it will create a link to every section you have on the page. If you use a list of sections, add disable-virtualization=true through the Attributes section on the list widget containing the section patterns.

Use the parameter isFixed to define if it will stick on scroll and the TopPosition to change the distance to top. 

Set IsSmooth to true to enable animated scroll.

Name: Separator
Description: Allows to split information with a horizontal line.

Name: Sidebar
Description: Display additional information on a floating panel on the side of the screen.

Name: StackedCards
Description:
Stacked cards with multiple items. For dynamic content, use a List directly inside the content placeholder.

The content to show when swipe left, right and top is dynamic and must be set by the user.

Ideal for creating a message board or display multiple images.

Name: StaticMap
Description:
Displays non-interactive map on your Reactive Web and Native Mobile apps using the Google Maps API.
To add markers to your map, use the StaticMarkers parameter. 

For more information, visit: https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/maps-static/start

Name: Submenu
Description: Menu item able to hold additional links inside the Submenu Items placeholder.

Name: Tabs
Description:
Set of Tabs with placeholders for Title and Content.

Fill in the headers and respective content areas of the tabs to be displayed. Empty tabs will not be rendered.

Used to display large sets of information which can be split into different areas, whilst always remaining a click away.

📝 To ensure predictable behavior and avoid runtime issues, the Tabs component is designed to include at least one TabsHeaderItem and one TabsContentItem.

Name: TabsContentItem
Description: Item for placeholder Content in the Tabs Block. Drag as many items as you need.

Name: TabsHeaderItem
Description:
Item for placeholder Header in the Tabs Block. Drag as many items as you need.

The headers can have rich information like counters, badges or icons.

Name: Tag
Description: Display text highlighting its importance.

Name: TerraDrawToolbarCSS
Description:
Custom CSS made to build the DrawingTools toolbar and tools, when the TerraDraw provider is used. 
Date: 20.03.2026
Github: https://github.com/OutSystems/outsystems-maps/blob/dev/styles/DrawingTools.css

Name: TimelineItem
Description:
Item to create a timeline of event information, with placeholders for icon, title text and actions.

Drag the Block to the screen, add your content and set if the item is active or not active.

Used to create sequence  of chronologically related events.

For Accessibility compliance, please set the 'role=list' attribute on the parent element.

Name: TimePicker
Description: Allows the user to select a time using a picker.

Name: Tooltip
Description:
Dynamic tooltip displaying simple content.

Drag the Block to the screen, add your content in the Content placeholder and then add the tooltip text in the Tooltip placeholder.

Use the Tooltip block to display additional information related to a screen element.

Name: TotalHoursMonth
Description: Total hours the current user logged in the selected month vs the hours expected, as a progress circle. Reloads when Year, Month or RefreshKey change.

Name: TouchEvents
Description: Enables touch events on a specific widget.

Name: UserAvatar
Description:
Display the picture or initials of a user.

Bind the name and picture of the user to the input parameters of the Block. If no picture exists, the user initials will be used by default.

Ideal to display information of the currently logged user.

Name: UserInfo
Description: Displays the currently logged in user and allows to log out. If no user is logged in, it links to the login screen.

Name: Video
Description:
Drag the pattern to the screen to add video content without the need for a third-party plug-in.
Note: The URL must be a direct video file, not a website like Vimeo or YouTube since those servers provide their own embed code.

Name: Wizard
Description:
Used to split larger tasks into more manageable steps. Usually supported by explicit button navigation to move forward and backward.

Drag as many WizardItems in the Content placeholder as you need.

Name: WizardItem
Description:
Step item to add in the Wizard pattern.

Drag the icon you want in the Icon placeholder and define the correspondent label in the Label placeholder. 
Use the Status parameter to define it's status (Past, Active, Next) and the LabelPosition to set it above (true) or alongside (false).
